title: Tenma Saki — Rainy Distance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And that's my homework done!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's club tomorrow too. I can't wait to go to school♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! I should also start thinking about which shift to take next at my part-time job!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm... I want to fill my schedule with as much fun stuff as possible, but I have band practice and club, so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uh... There are so many things I want to do, but not enough time to do them all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah! No, wait a minute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If I get too greedy and start doing everything at once, I'll just fall sick again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Why do I always fall sick at the worst possible times?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess I should prioritize staying healthy over all else!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh. Maybe I can find a useful website about this if I do some research on my smartphone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see, I'll search for... Ah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, I found something good♪
The next day
Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So sorry I'm late!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We weren't waiting that long.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Okay, let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Time to dig in!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why are you holding on to your smartphone, though?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't tell me you mistook it for chopsticks or something.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course not!
I'm just taking a picture!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Picture? Of your lunch?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup! Heh heh heh!
I found this really useful app yesterday. Look!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is an app that helps you manage your health♪ And it's got such a cute design too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wow, it really is cute.
What does it actually do?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think it records your temperature and weight, and also comes with a pedometer. You can also keep tabs on your meals by taking pictures!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So that's why you were trying to take a picture.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! But it doesn't just keep records!
The app also informs you about what nutrients you may be lacking in your diet!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It even gives out beauty tips and great advice on how to lose weight!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's more! Using the app earns you points, which you can then exchange for freebies!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sounds like a case of too good to be true to me, though?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not possible! I did my own research on the company that produced this app, and it's all good. See? This company!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, this company makes health foods.
I know about them because I often come across their commercials.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That means the app was made by a reputable company.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess that means it's safe to use, then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Told you! Anyway, I'm gonna make full use of this app to get even healthier than ever!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Zero absences, here I come!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, you're such an amazing person, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. You're always so positive, and that's amazing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just don't forget that we're here for you, so don't hold back if you ever need help from us, understand?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (She's right. I have three friends I've known since I was little right here with me, who care so much about me!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! You bet I will!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Make sure you remember that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Shiho! I love you♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey! Stop it, Saki!
Don't be like my sister!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But why? I'm just trying to show how much I love you♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, Honami, stop watching and help me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm, what should I do...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. But Shiho looks so happy!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: D-Don't say that! Now Saki's going to do it more!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I looove you!
